text:
Mara: Quick sync  benchmark narrative shift: move from mean-latency charts to a tail-SLA + unit-cost story. Want visuals that show which serving configs reliably hit 99th pct SLAs at what $/1M tokens.

Devin: Agree. Product teams care about tail under load, not averages.

Sam: Design asks: three panels
- Panel 1: SLA compliance curve: P(99th <= X ms) vs $/1M, lines per config
- Panel 2: cost breakdown per 100k requests (batch/cache/compute)
- Panel 3: persona tradeoffs (chat/search/embeddings) with recommended knobs

Leah: Drop a tiny CSV so design can mock?

Mara: CSV (latency_ms,small_batch,medium_batch,prefix_cache):
150,0.60,0.74,0.92
200,0.77,0.88,0.98
250,0.89,0.95,0.995
300,0.94,0.985,0.999
Costs $/1M: small_batch=1250,medium_batch=800,prefix_cache=410

Tom: Add axis labels: "P(99th <= X ms)" and "$ per 1M tokens". Overlay cost ticks.

Mara: Hero copy candidates
A) "Keep the tail snappy: 99th under 250ms at predictable unit cost"
B) "2-3x lower spend while preserving tail latency"
C) "SLA-ready inference across chat, search, embeddings"

Sam: B hits acquisition.

Leah: Webinar plan: 30m (20 demo,10 QA). Demo flow: synthetic load -> flip routing + enable cache -> show 99th stays in SLA and cost drops. Record 5-min clip for LP.

Devin: Eng will provide reproducible traffic script + 99th trace annotation. ETA 72h.

Tom: Demand-gen tags: ["lead:tail-sla","lead:unit-econ","lead:embeddings-eff"], nurture: whitepaper -> 5-min clip -> sales config templates.

Mara: Action items: design mock by Thu EOD; content one-pager + script; growth wires tags. Drop early PNGs here; I'll finalize hero claim by Fri.

marketing-bot: Sprint created: "benchmark-sla-visuals" due in 10 days. :rocket:
